name: Triad Lilytear
original_name: トライアド・リリーティア
source:
After ridding the world of Libido and erasing everyone's memories of her embarrassing actions Nanamiya Luna AKA, Lunaly Lily is attacked by a Libido on the street. Coming to her rescue is Hiba Airi AKA, Lovely Lily. But weren't the Libido defeated? What's going on? Soon after the pair are joined by Minamori Touka AKA, Magical College Girl Christhea. They explain that they've come back in time, Lovely Lily from the year 2013 and Christhea from the year 2020 to help out Lunaly Lily in the past. Something is disrupting the timeline.

Before they can defeat the Libido Magical Girl Tearheart arrives and accuses the girls of being Shameless, a type of evil Succubus who work with Libido and get joy from exposing themselves and tempting men with shameless actions. The girls are forced to run away. Shabi, the cute pet partner of Lovely Lily explains that despite Tearheart's actions many people will be hurt if they don't collect SE energy, the energy from embarrassed girls to use their magical powers to fight the Libido. The girls band together and resolve that despite the embarrassment and the accusations of Tearheart they need to continue to commit embarrassing actions to collect SE energy and fight Libido!
translation:
在消除了世界上的性欲并消除了每个人对她的尴尬行为（又名七宫露娜）的记忆后，月神莉莉在街上遭到了性欲的攻击。来拯救她的是Hiba Airi，又名“可爱的莉莉”。但力比多不是被打败了吗？这是怎么回事？不久之后，南森藤花（又名魔法女大学生克莉丝蒂亚）也加入了两人的行列。他们解释说，他们是从2013年回来的Lovely Lily，从2020年回来的Christhea，来帮助过去的Lunaly Lily。有什么东西正在打乱时间线。

在她们击败性欲魔法少女泪心之前到来，并指责女孩们无耻，这是一种邪恶的魅魔，她们与性欲合作，通过暴露自己并用无耻的行为引诱男人来获得快乐。女孩们被迫逃跑。可爱莉莉的可爱宠物伙伴沙比解释说，尽管泪心采取了行动，但如果不收集SE能量，许多人都会受到伤害，SE能量来自尴尬的女孩，可以利用她们的魔法力量来对抗性欲。女孩们团结起来，决定尽管存在尴尬和泪心的指责，但她们仍需要继续做出尴尬的行为来收集SE能量并对抗性欲！
